approvals.name: create_video_from_text

args.name: Bugatti driving across Golden Gate Bridge

style.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic automotive footage. Use @car as the exact vehicle reference: preserve this pale ice-blue Bugatti supercar's distinctive body shape, black horseshoe grille, slim headlights, dark glass and silver wheels. Use @bridge as the location reference: Golden Gate Bridge with its orange-red suspension towers, cables, roadway, blue water and clear blue daytime sky. Show the referenced Bugatti driving smoothly forward in its lane across the Golden Gate Bridge, with naturally rotating wheels and realistic reflections. Low front three-quarter tracking shot from a camera moving alongside and ahead of the car at matching speed, keeping the whole car clearly visible as the bridge cables and red towers move past behind it. Continuous single shot, realistic scale and road contact, sunny daylight. No exhibition platform, no crowd around the car, no cuts, no text.
